OTT Application

← Back to Featured Work

Collaborate with in-house and contracted developers, as well as an external company, to build an OTT app from the ground up with live streaming capabilities for Jentezen Franklin Media Ministries. The “Jentezen Franklin TV” app is available on platforms including Apple TV, iOS devices, Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Samsung TV, LG TV, and Google TV. Since its launch in early 2024, the app has garnered over 16,000 downloads.
